conflict.contested_grid: The entity with the higher order_key moves first; the loser waits in place and a 'blocked' event is logged. No passing through another entity.
conflict.contested_item: First mover takes it; the later entity receives a 'target no longer there' failure and the utility AI / DM picks a different action. Two entities never receive the same item.
conflict.contested_trade_target: Same rule as contested items: first mover wins, the other gets the failure reason.
conflict.note: Only 'announced and confirmed' actions consume a tick. DM narration and player discussion do not consume ticks.

energy.formula: speed is recomputed each tick from current body state (organ/limb health, load, fatigue); energy += speed each round
energy.note: Base 100 is only the data default for action costs, not a code constant.

note: v1.3: no single agility stat. Order is two-phase: reaction (perception/intelligence/will) decides who acts first; execution speed is per-action, computed from the relevant body parts and stats. See data/rules/action_speed.json for the full per-action profiles.

order_key.formula: order_key = reaction + d20 (WorldRng); reaction = 0.5 * perception + 0.3 * intelligence + 0.2 * will
order_key.tie_break: Equal order_key values sort by entity_id, so the order is deterministic for a given seed.
